page_title: UDI 1-2 ROM | Udinese v AS Roma 25/04/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's it for today, Luca Pairetto has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+6' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Udinese.
90+5' 1 - 2 GOAL! The corner is whipped in and Bryan Cristante (AS Roma) is in the right place at the right time, planting his header straight into the bottom right corner. He makes it 1:2.
90+5' The ball goes out for a corner. AS Roma can continue in their attacking effort.
90+4' AS Roma can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
90+3' Daniele De Rossi has decided to make a change. Stephan El Shaarawy (AS Roma) replaces Rick Karsdorp.
90+3' Rick Karsdorp (AS Roma) receives a yellow card from the referee as expected.
90+3' Lazar Samardzic (Udinese) takes the corner but it's cleared.
90+2' Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a precise pass. He pulls the trigger but only hits one of the opposition, who gets in the way of his effort.
90+1' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Nehuen Perez trots off the pitch and is replaced by Christian Kabasele (Udinese).
90' We will have 4 min. of added time.
88' Daniele De Rossi has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Diego Llorente (AS Roma) replacing Chris Smalling.
87' Jordan Zemura (Udinese) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
83' Martin Payero (Udinese) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.
82' None of the Udinese players could reach the corner kick as the ball was overhit and goes out of play.

82' Mile Svilar pulls off a superb save! He leapt to block the shot Lorenzo Lucca (Udinese) fired on target after a rebound. His effort from inside the box flew straight towards the bottom right corner. The referee blows his whistle, Udinese are awarded a corner kick.
80' Gianluca Mancini (AS Roma) makes an unfair challenge by holding his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball.
79' Angelino (AS Roma) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
76' Sardar Azmoun (AS Roma) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
76' Nehuen Perez (Udinese) makes a rough challenge and Luca Pairetto blows his whistle for a foul.
75' The linesman raises his flag. Tammy Abraham (AS Roma) is adjudged offside.
74' AS Roma string together a series of short passes.
73' The match can continue after the interruption.
73' Daniele De Rossi decides to make a substitution. Nicola Zalewski will be replaced by Leonardo Spinazzola (AS Roma).
73' Substitution. Tommaso Baldanzi is replaced by Sardar Azmoun (AS Roma).
73' The game has come to an end for Romelu Lukaku. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Tammy Abraham (AS Roma).
73' Leandro Paredes comes off the pitch to be replaced by Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma).
73' Substitution. Evan Ndicka makes his way off the pitch and Gianluca Mancini (AS Roma) comes on as his replacement.
73' We are about to witness a substitution. Chris Smalling (AS Roma) is replacing Diego Llorente.
73' The players and officials agreed that the match has to be abandoned due to a serious injury.
73' The ref halts play as there’s an injured player that needs attention.
73' It doesn’t look good for Evan Ndicka (AS Roma); looks like he’ll have to leave the pitch!
70' Here is a change. Kingsley Ehizibue is going off and Fabio Cannavaro gives the last tactical orders to Joao Ferreira (Udinese).
70' Hassane Kamara goes off the pitch and Jordan Zemura (Udinese) comes on.
70' AS Roma failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
69' Romelu Lukaku (AS Roma) is first to the rebound and sends a header goalwards but it's blocked. Wow, what an escape there for the opposition.
69' Tommaso Baldanzi (AS Roma) picks up a caution.
66' Luca Pairetto shows a yellow card to Martin Payero (Udinese) for a tough tackle.
64' 1 - 1 Goal! Romelu Lukaku (AS Roma) makes the score 1:1 after burying a close-range header into the roof of the net after a good run and cross by Bryan Cristante.
64' Nicola Zalewski (AS Roma) is first to the rebound but his shot is blocked. Wow, what an escape there for the opposition.
62' Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) receives the ball from the set piece on the edge of the box, but fails to score because his shot is blocked.
60' Kingsley Ehizibue (Udinese) performs a sliding tackle but catches his opponent's legs. The referee blows his whistle for an infringement. A free kick is awarded to AS Roma.
59' The resulting set piece from AS Roma is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
59' Bryan Cristante (AS Roma) crosses the ball forward but it is intercepted. The ball goes out of play. AS Roma are awarded a corner kick.
58' Luca Pairetto shows the yellow card to Jaka Bijol (Udinese) for a heavy challenge.
57' Romelu Lukaku (AS Roma) is adjudged offside.
56' Lazar Samardzic (Udinese) shoots after receiving a good pass. His effort from the edge of the box goes just wide of the left post.
55' Chance! Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) was in a good position inside the box, but he couldn't connect with the pass as it was overhit.
54' Flag up against Lorenzo Lucca (Udinese). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
53' Daniele De Rossi has decided to substitute Dean Huijsen and he is replaced by Rick Karsdorp (AS Roma).
53' The manager makes a subsitution with Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) coming on for Houssem Aouar.
51' Lorenzo Lucca (Udinese) receives a precise pass and finds some space for a shot. The keeper is alert and denies his long-range effort towards the roof of the net. Decent save!
51' Angelino (AS Roma) sends a cross into the box, but Maduka Okoye comes off his line to gather the ball.
50' Angelino (AS Roma) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
49' Leandro Paredes (AS Roma) gets to the rebound outside the penalty box and unleashes a long-range shot towards the bottom left corner, but Maduka Okoye makes a decent save to stop the effort.
49' Nehuen Perez (Udinese) pulls the shirt of his opponent and only escapes without punishment due to the benevolence of the referee.
46' Roberto Pereyra (Udinese) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
46' The second half has just started.
45+2' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+1' The corner from Leandro Paredes (AS Roma) is intercepted by the defence.
45+1' The ball goes out of play and AS Roma have been awarded a corner kick. A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Angelino (AS Roma), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
45' 1 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
44' Lorenzo Lucca (Udinese) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Luca Pairetto blows for a foul.
44' Some neat passing and movement from AS Roma as they ping around some short passes in order to create a new attacking opportunity.
41' Hassane Kamara (Udinese) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Mile Svilar, who smothers the ball.

39' Romelu Lukaku (AS Roma) has a great chance on the edge of the six-yard box following a lofted pass, but his header lacks accuracy and flies just past the right post. The ball goes out of play and Udinese will have a goal kick.
38' Leandro Paredes (AS Roma) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance.
38' A cross from Nicola Zalewski (AS Roma) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.

37' Houssem Aouar (AS Roma) is picked out by his teammate with a brilliant short pass, but it takes him too long to control the ball inside the box and this allows one of the defending players to rob him.
34' Houssem Aouar (AS Roma) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Maduka Okoye intercepts the ball.
32' Leandro Paredes (AS Roma) picks up a pass, nutmegs an opponent and goes for glory with an effort from distance. It's a poor effort, however, and goes well wide of the left post.
31' Hassane Kamara (Udinese) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
30' Leandro Paredes (AS Roma) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Luca Pairetto blows his whistle for a foul.
29' Houssem Aouar (AS Roma) was all set to receive a beautiful pass into a promising position. However, one of the defenders makes a timely clearance.
26' Romelu Lukaku (AS Roma) unleashes a missile of a shot towards goal, but his good effort is blocked by one of the defenders.
23' 1 - 0 Goal! A mistake from the defence gifted a chance to a lurking Roberto Pereyra (Udinese), who keeps his cool and rolls the ball into the net from close range. 1:0.
22' Leandro Paredes (AS Roma) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.

21' Tommaso Baldanzi (AS Roma) collects a rebound and produces a mid-range attempt. The ball goes to the bottom left corner, but Maduka Okoye keeps it out with an amazing save. The referee signals a corner kick to AS Roma.
21' The corner kick from Leandro Paredes (AS Roma) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders.

21' Angelino (AS Roma) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to AS Roma.
20' Lazar Samardzic (Udinese) is penalised for holding. Luca Pairetto signals a set piece.
18' Romelu Lukaku (AS Roma) commits a foul and Luca Pairetto immediately signals a free kick.

17' What a miss! Houssem Aouar (AS Roma) is left standing right in front of goal with only the keeper to beat after a clever pass, but he somehow contrives to toe poke the ball just past the right post.
16' A dangerous towering header by Thomas Kristensen (Udinese) from around the penalty spot goes just wide of the left post. This corner kick didn't change the score.
16' Lazar Samardzic (Udinese) is about to take a corner kick.
15' Kingsley Ehizibue (Udinese) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players. The linesman makes the right call and Udinese will have a corner.
13' Udinese are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
13' The match is abandoned!
11' The game is interrupted as Houssem Aouar (AS Roma) is flagged offside.
9' Lorenzo Lucca (Udinese) flashes a header well wide of the left post following a lofted pass into the centre of the box.
7' Hassane Kamara (Udinese) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
6' Roberto Pereyra (Udinese) attempted to pick out a free teammate inside the box, but Mile Svilar comes off the line to clear the ball away.
5' Kingsley Ehizibue (Udinese) does well to dispossess the attacker with a slide tackle, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
4' Lazar Samardzic (Udinese) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
3' An attempted cross from Hassane Kamara (Udinese) is cleared.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
The players are out at last! AS Roma will take the kick-off.
Luca Pairetto will referee today's match.
